name: My Scores
intro: You will watch My Scores fill in a made-up league (the “Sunday Funday League”) so you can check the scoreboard, roster, Assistant Manager and standings, then try the “add a team” questions with links that are not real. You don’t need a fantasy team of your own, and nothing here uses real scores.

steps.do: On the welcome card at the bottom (“Welcome to My Scores”), tap “▶ Start the tour”.
steps.see: The card changes to “😩 The problem it solves”, with “Next ›” and a small “‹” button.
steps.tip: A green greeting strip may also show at the top (for example “Good morning.”). Tap its ✕ if it is in the way.

steps.do: Tap “Next ›” five times, reading each card as you go (the last one is “💛 Free, no sign-up”).
steps.see: You reach a card titled “Now watch it work” with two buttons: “▶ Show me” and “Skip the demo”.
Behind the card a scoreboard appears for “SUNDAY FUNDAY LEAGUE (EXAMPLE)”. The card says “Here’s a scoreboard card, filled with an example league so you can see it.”

A gold box goes around the two teams: “Your Team (example)” with 87.40 on the left and “Gridiron Grandpas (example)” with 74.20 on the right. Under the box: “You're ahead by 13.20” and “Win odds 64%”.
The red ⏰ warning is highlighted: “Marcus Bell (example) (RB, OUT) — game starts in 45 min”.

Your team’s roster opens: QB Sam Rivers (example) 18.20, RB Dee Walker (example) 14.60 and so on, with a small O tag next to Marcus Bell and a Q tag next to Andre Lowe. A color key reads “playing now · not started · finished · bye”.
The 🧢 Assistant Manager box opens. Under “LINEUP SUGGESTIONS” it says “Bench Jay Monroe (example) … instead of Marcus Bell (example)”, and lower down there are “WAIVER WIRE” and “BYE WEEKS” sections.
The card has slid sideways to the league’s other game: “Touchdown Tillies (example)” 65.00 vs “Fourth & Long (example)” 71.50, and “Cousin Ray leads by 6.50”.

Now the “STANDINGS” show: 1 Your Team (example) 4-1, 2 Gridiron Grandpas, 3 Touchdown Tillies, 4 Fourth & Long. Under “RECENT ACTIVITY”: “Uncle Joe picked up Max Field (example), dropped Al Stone (example)”.
A big blue “Update scores” button is lifted up and highlighted, and the card’s button now says “Done with this part ›”.
The card asks “Want the screen-by-screen tour?” (“About 8 minutes”) with “Yes, show me every screen” and “No thanks, I’ve got it”.
A card says “🎉 You’re ready” with a “Let’s go ›” button.
The example league is gone. The screen asks “WHERE DO YOU PLAY THIS TEAM?” with a box that says “Paste your team or league link” and a blue “Find my league” button.

steps.do: Leave the box empty and tap “Find my league”.
steps.see: Nothing is searched. A message under the button says “Paste a link first.”

steps.do: Tap the box and type this made-up Yahoo link, then tap “Find my league”.
steps.see: The message says “That doesn't look like an ESPN or Sleeper link. Paste the page you see when you open your team.” (The card below explains that Yahoo isn’t supported yet.)

steps.do: Clear the box, type this (with the apostrophe), and tap “Find my league”.
steps.see: The same friendly message shows again (“That doesn't look like an ESPN or Sleeper link…”). Nothing freezes and your words stay in the box.

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “Cancel” under the Yahoo card.
steps.see: A “MY TEAMS” screen: “These are the teams this screen follows.” and “No teams yet. Tap + Add a team below.” with a “+ Add a team” button.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: My Scores opens on the “WHERE DO YOU PLAY THIS TEAM?” question again (you still have no teams), and the tour does not start over. A card “Keep My Scores on your Home Screen” may slide up — tap “Later”.

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “Cancel”, then tap “+ Add a team”.
steps.see: You go to “MY TEAMS” (“No teams yet.”) and then straight back to “WHERE DO YOU PLAY THIS TEAM?”, ready for a real ESPN or Sleeper link whenever you have one.
